2026-08-04T12:51:38.8674790Z Repository permission level: write
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8780659Z text: Update histogram temporality limitation — now supported on OTLP endpoint (9.5+ / serverless)
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8781334Z 
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8783147Z The [Histograms in delta temporality only](https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/opentelemetry/compatibility/limitations#histograms-in-delta-temporality-only) limitation in `docs/reference/compatibility/limitations.md` is no longer accurate as a blanket statement.
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8784386Z 
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8784650Z ## What changed
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8830964Z 
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8832475Z Both delta and cumulative temporality are now supported for histograms and counters when sending data using the **ES OTLP endpoint** or **motlp** — on Elastic Stack 9.5+ and already on serverless. The relevant docs are at [Metric temporality](https://www.elastic.co/docs/manage-data/ingest/otlp-endpoint#metric-temporality).
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8840893Z 
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8841591Z Note: cumulative temporality for histograms additionally requires `xpack.otel_data.histogram_field_type` set to `exponential_histogram` (which is the default on 9.4+).
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8842276Z 
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8842385Z ## Caveat
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8842781Z 
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8843677Z The **collector Elasticsearch exporter** does NOT support this yet — the limitation still applies when using that path. Work to add it is planned, but blocked on native exponential histogram support first.
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8845479Z 
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8845701Z ## Proposed doc change (lines 61–65)
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8846472Z 
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8846641Z - Update the section title (no longer "only delta")
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8847105Z - Scope the remaining delta-only restriction to the ES exporter path
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8847658Z - Add a note pointing to the metric temporality docs for the OTLP endpoint path
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8848251Z - Add appropriate `applies_to` tags (stack: 9.5 / serverless for the lifted restriction)
2026-08-04T12:51:38.8848997Z title: Update histogram temporality limitation — now supported on OTLP endpoint (9.5+ / serverless)

2026-08-04T12:51:38.8851583Z

The relevant docs are at [Metric temporality](https://www.elastic.co/docs/manage-data/ingest/otlp-endpoint#metric-temporality).
